title: RDW–MCV coupling did not improve thyroid-stimulating-hormone prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A centered RDW–MCV interaction did not establish incremental prediction of log TSH beyond flexible additive CBC and demographic predictors. In separately sampled NHANES2007–2008(n=4749)and2009–2010(n=1771), target weighted MSE gain was-0.000216(400 source+target PSU-refit95%interval-0.005059to0.001583);source cross-validation gain was also negative. External non-NHANES validation was not completed;this is not an equivalence result.
